entries.title: Draft exact influence range and extremizer for bent point splices
entries.statement: DRAFT author-derived result, independent review pending. Fix even m>=4, N=2^m, and Boolean g on the uniform m-cube with |hat(g)(T)|=1/sqrt(N) for every T. For a vertex a set h=g-2g(a)1_{z=a}, F(z,+1)=g(z), F(z,-1)=h(z), and s_g(a)=#{j:g(a)!=g(a+e_j)}. Then I(F)=m/2+(m+1-2s_g(a))/N; each s=0,...,m is attainable by a character twist of the canonical quadratic bent base. Put R=sqrt(N), K_+=(N+R)/2, K_-=(N-R)/2 and phi(t)=t log_2(1/t), phi(0)=0. H(F)=E_m=K_+phi((R-1)^2/N^2)+K_-phi((R+1)^2/N^2)+Nphi(1/N^2), independent of g and a. At fixed m the sharp class maximum H/I is E_m/[m/2-(m-1)/N], attained by the full-parity twist flipped at zero. At m=4 this example has I=29/16 and H>469/128>2I, so a canonical constant-2 bound does not extend to all bent splices. Every such splice still satisfies H<=3I. These are class results; general FEI is not proved and novelty is not certified.
assumptions: one flipped vertex on one selector branch

relations.rationale: An exact restricted-class entropy/influence calculation with an unproved global FEI gap; no solution or refutation of the parent target.
